data.notes: As of October 2026, the only solid March 2027 music-travel event I could verify in or very near Marrakech is Wilco’s three-night destination run; club and festival calendars have not yet published confirmed March 2027 programming.

events.title: Wilco in Morocco
events.summary: Wilco perform three unique, no-repeat nights in Marrakech as part of a destination concert experience presented with Pilgrimage of Sound. The official event materials list the run for March 25, 26 and 27, 2027 at Palm Events Center.
